notes: Reconciliation: the interrogative הֲ takes no English auxiliary. הַאֶרְצֶה is realigned so the particle is unrepresented and the imperfect אֶרְצֶה carries the whole “should I accept” under rule 17, matching הֲיִרְצְךָ and הֲיִשָּׂא in MAL.1.8-9 and the same verb form אֶרְצֶה → “will I accept” in MAL.1.10.
